match.reason: No bank point teaches that a large-scale map shows a small area in detail and a small-scale map shows a large area with less detail; the closest points cover study scope (geo-scale), calculating real distances from a map ratio (mat-scale-maps), or scale as one map part (geo-map-conventions), which are different ideas.

draft.title: Large-scale and small-scale maps
card: shows a small area of land in great detail. A map of one town or one beach is large scale. Houses, streets and small creeks can be seen.
shows a large area of land with little detail. A map of a whole country or continent is small scale. Only big features such as states, major cities and oceans can be seen.
The names can seem backwards. Think of a ratio as a fraction: 1 to 10,000 is a bigger fraction than 1 to 1,000,000. So the 1 to 10,000 map is the larger scale, even though it covers less land.
Pick the scale that suits the job. Use a large-scale map to find a walking track. Use a small-scale map to compare the size of two countries.
draft.remember: Large scale: small area, lots of detail. Small scale: large area, little detail.

opts: A map of one suburb showing each house
A map of Australia showing the capital cities
A map of the world showing the oceans
A map of New South Wales showing major highways
a.why: A map of one suburb covers a small area and shows each house, so it is large scale. The other three cover large areas and show only major features, so they are small scale.
a.clue: Which map covers the smallest area?

b.q: Priya is planning a bushwalk around Lake Burley Griffin in Canberra. She wants to see each track and footbridge. Which map should she choose?
opts: 1 to 10,000, because it is the larger scale
1 to 5,000,000, because it covers a larger area
1 to 10,000, because it is the smaller scale
1 to 5,000,000, because it shows more detail
b.why: Small features such as tracks and footbridges show up on a large-scale map. 1 to 10,000 is a bigger fraction than 1 to 5,000,000, so it is the larger scale. The 1 to 5,000,000 map covers more land but shows far less detail.
b.clue: Which ratio is the bigger fraction?

a.best: A map of one suburb showing each house

b.best: 1 to 10,000, because it is the larger scale
